Request: queues the action string for the objects the name matches (under the object mutex)
CreateEffect kinds: NegaPosi, Monochrome, Sepia, KitanoBlue, Drop, FloatBubble, Rain, LookupRain, Mosaic, LowWave ... Ripple
compares product_code with ZokuSatsurikunoJyango; set_system_variable quits when it differs
#SYSTEM_play_speed (set_system_variable case 0): the text speed level, clamped 1-12 (default 3, 0045cb30); the variable is written back
the per-character time of the current play_speed level (a table of doubles at 00529408 + 8 * level), or a fixed one while skipping
$SYSTEM_skip: skip mode on or off (set_system_variable case 14; turned off by menu_lock and skip_lock, and by MoviePlay)
$SYSTEM_text_auto: auto mode from the variable (set_system_variable case 10)
$SYSTEM_text_erase: hides (1) or shows (0) the text window (case 12; shown again by menu_lock and text_erase_lock; WaitKey shows it)
$SYSTEM_low_thread_priority (case 29): SetThreadPriority -1 or 0 on the game thread
appends one character to $SYSTEM_last_text (set_system_variable case 26 feeds the string through it; also SetBacklog and the text layout)
the settings' defaults (play_speed 3, skip off, ...)
reads $SYSTEM_menu_enable, backlog_enable, menu_back_select, menu_load/save/config/close/reset_enable, save_lock, load_lock by name
keys and clicks outside the script: reads $SYSTEM_text_auto, menu_enable, menu_config_enable, load_lock, save_lock, backselect_lock by name

MSVC CRT: the next (multi-byte) character
Request Erase: switches the object's per-frame callback to the erasing one
Request Enter: stamps the start time (timeGetTime) and switches the callback to the showing one (a text object starts typing out)
Request Smoothing: sets the texture's filtering flag (0x1000)
Request UnSmoothing: clears it
Request NormalRender: blend mode 0x101 (normal alpha)
Request AddRender: blend mode 2 (additive)
Request SubRender: blend mode 3 (subtractive)
sets the Direct3D blend or filter state from an object's flags

column3: Shake's work: n > 1000 does nothing; flip interval 1000/(n*0.001*fps) into the job (+0x4c), tempo (+0xa0)
per-object Shake setup: steps = time*fps*0.001, tempo tables for |x1-x0|, |y1-y0|; frame callback shake_frame
draws the object at sign*(x0 +- table[step]); the sign flips once the flip interval has passed
tempo name (byte sum) -> table builder (Dxl2 00441240: 1-(1-t)^3)
table of dist*(1-(1-i/n)^3), i = 0..n
game speed tables at 0x531a5c (ms a frame 1,2,4,8,16,...) and 0x531a90 (fps 960,...,60,...), index byte 0x531a40 = 4
CreateWindow's work: last argument not TRUE clears +0x3c8 (children placed from the screen)
an object's place from its x, y text, from its parent's corner when the parent's +0x3c8 is set
new object: +0x3c8 = 1, place from the parent's when the parent's +0x3c8 is set
